notes.title: Call notes, Oct 23: Sunbeam Pediatrics, visit to the Lakeview clinic
notes.text:
Friday October 23, 2026, 40 min, in person at the Lakeview clinic. Sunbeam: Marcus Oyelaran (Practice Manager), Dr. Aisha Rahman (Medical Director), Tom Nakamura (Front Desk Lead). Kite: Lena Fischer, Priyanka Shah (Onboarding).

Six clinics, 14 providers, about 1,100 visits a week. No-show rate was 11 percent in September (Marcus pulled the report last week). Front desk staff make reminder calls by hand on Thursday afternoons for the following week; Tom said it takes two people most of the afternoon and they still miss people. Well-visit recall letters go out by mail twice a year. Parents ask for text reminders; the clinics have no texting today. Their EHR stays with its current vendor.

Dr. Rahman: any text that goes to parents gets reviewed by the clinical team first. A text never includes a diagnosis or a reason for the visit.

Agreed: a 30 day trial at the Lakeview and Northgate clinics starting Tuesday November 17. Tom sends the reminder call script and the September no-show report by Friday October 30. Priyanka sends the EHR connection checklist and sample parent texts by Tuesday November 3. The clinical team reviews the texts before go-live. Next call Friday November 6 to confirm the connection and the text wording. After the trial, Marcus wants a number for the other four clinics before the year ends; Lena to send it.

Resources: EHR connection checklist (https://kite.example/docs/ehr-checklist), sample parent texts (https://kite.example/samples/parent-texts), the reminders walkthrough video Lena showed on the tablet (https://kite.example/video/reminders-walkthrough).

notes.title: Transcript, Oct 23 visit (phone recording)
notes.text:
[00:03:30] Marcus Oyelaran: September was 11 percent no-shows. I pulled it last week. That is a lot of empty slots for 14 providers.
[00:05:12] Tom Nakamura: Thursday afternoons, two of us call next week's list. It takes most of the afternoon and we still miss people.
[00:09:48] Dr. Aisha Rahman: I am fine with texts, with two conditions. My team reads every message before it goes out, and a message never says why the child is coming in.
[00:10:05] Lena Fischer: Both are standard for us. The texts say the time, the clinic and how to reschedule, nothing else.
[00:22:40] Marcus Oyelaran: Start with Lakeview and Northgate. If the trial works I need a number for the other four before the year ends.
[00:23:10] Priyanka Shah: Thirty days from November 17. I will send the connection checklist and the sample texts by the third so the clinical team has time.
[00:23:30] Tom Nakamura: I will get you the call script and the September report by the end of next week.
